nodes.label: infra Scope
nodes.rationale: The one scope that leans on the back half of the graph (13 of 32): skips ideation and the application-code stages, runs practices-discovery, the NFR pass, infrastructure-design, ci-pipeline and the full deployment/observability set. Uniquely SKIPs reverse-engineering because infra changes start from deployment topology rather than application source, and it is the only non-enterprise/feature scope that runs the operation phase.
